limits: Stationary disposable loopback stock-server fixtures, not moving-target, latency, anticheat or arbitrary-terrain compatibility proof.
Ledge cases establish bounded trench refusal, not pathfinding or immunity to external pushes.
These controller fixtures disable Strafe and Sword Jump crits; Crystal uses Use anchors=false. They do not prove bot strafing, bot critical jumping, or its Anchor branch.
Target health1000/resistance fail-safes and explicitly selected Crystal equipment model are test settings, not default safety claims.
Aim recent-input positive uses official MouseHandler motion; idle negative requires actual target motion. This is not OS hardware input proof.
Live menu/Panic/module-off slot tests observed borrowed axe and restoration before ordinary two-tick expiry; manual override stays user-owned.
Native master UI case proves suppression/reactivation only. Opening Options can already cancel transient work, so it does not isolate live-lease master-off cleanup.
Controller intent cases here use explicit chat commands. Later native GUI same-value intent changes are not claimed by R7.
Screenshots are original postcase frames; damage, trajectories, confirmation and timing measurements come from retained native reports/traces.
Raw reports remain private; public index includes exact hashes and selected extracted evidence without local account paths or authentication data.
